messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I would like to write out a dataframe to an xlsx file where I set the
cell format of one or more columns to "text".  The goal is to prevent
text like "March1" being converted to dates.  Is this possible, and if
so could you tell me how?  Apologies if this is obvious.

Thanks,

Vince
